name: Gajendra Arha
summary:
As a 6x Certified NetSuite Techno-Functional Lead with over 14 years
of experience, I specialize in architecting and delivering scalable ERP
solutions that streamline financial and operational processes across
global organizations. I have successfully led 50+ end-to-end NetSuite
implementations across manufacturing and wholesale distribution,
covering all major modules—Finance, Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-
Cash (O2C), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Taxation—with a proven
track record of enhancing efficiency through automation, data integrity,
and system integration.
My expertise spans solution design, configuration, SuiteFlow
automation, integration architecture, and UAT/SIT leadership, ensuring
seamless deployments & strong post-go-live success. I’m passionate about
building automated, data-driven environments using SuiteAnalytics
Workbooks, custom reports, & dashboards to deliver real-time financial
visibility, ensure compliance, & accelerate financial close cycles.
A hands-on project leader, I have guided cross-functional teams and
coordinated with global resources to deliver projects on time and within
budget. Skilled in client discovery, solution design, and collaborating with
Finance and Operations leaders to build scalable, data-driven solutions,
I also develop dashboards, analytics, and training that drive user
adoption, improve financial visibility, and strengthen internal controls.
Beyond implementation, I contribute to solution architecture, pre-sales
consulting, and team mentoring, promoting best practices and
continuous improvement. My leadership in regional consulting (India,
Middle East, SE Asia) has delivered measurable business outcomes—40%
client expansion and 60% revenue uplift—through quality, collaboration,
and innovation.
